brief: Vendor-owned content is a genuinely productive route into the CZ banking/payments supplier landscape, but it is highly concentrated: Temenos (Komerční banka core, since 2021, LTIMindtree as SI), Diebold Nixdorf (ČSOB managed services since 2001, ~1,025 devices; KB as DN Series 300 pilot) and Euronet (a long, dated IR archive naming Česká spořitelna, Citibank CZ, Bank Austria Creditanstalt CZ and ABN AMRO CZ) account for most named CZ references found. Investor-relations newsrooms outperform marketing case-study libraries: they are dated, archived and enumerate deals the case-study pages have since dropped, and bank-side disclosures (KB's Worldline stake sales) supply the hard commercial detail vendor marketing omits. Czech-language search was essential but paid off differently — it surfaced local integrators' 'případové studie' (Salesforce at Česká spořitelna, MS Dynamics at Raiffeisenbank) and Asseco's cs reference lists rather than anything from the global vendors, so collection should be split into English newsroom crawls plus Czech SI/reference-page crawls. The main blind spots are FIS/Fiserv, the hyperscaler customer-story libraries, and web-archive recovery of withdrawn reference pages.
